## Abstract

The Technology Architecture domain encompasses decisions related to technology stack selections, platform choices, integration patterns, development tooling, and technology standards. This domain establishes the foundational technology decisions that guide enterprise-wide technology adoption and standardization.

Technology architecture decisions directly impact development productivity, system interoperability, maintenance costs, and long-term technology sustainability across the organization.
